justified_tb_changes.reason: The reset task releases reset before an idle positive clock edge preceding the next stimulus task. Stale ground=0 previously caused a legitimate fall on this edge while the oracle incorrectly retained walking. Neutral walking inputs keep that idle edge stable without weakening any expected outputs or checks.
